The interface reads all client master fields that are relevant for a company/other for a collection of client sequence numbers.
The fields are returned as a collection.
No check for companies/other takes place, i.e. a result is delivered for all main types.

Error handling:
This method may return the following gRPC error codes with additional error details:
Disclaimer: When data is read from BORD, only BORD related exceptions and annotation-based invalid argument exceptions will be thrown.

- INVALID_ARGUMENT
  * common.finnova.com.ValidationFailed:
    The transmitted data does not conform to the validation requirements.
    The collection 'clientKeys' must not be null and must contain at least one client key. All parameters must be filled correctly in accordance with the defined annotations and validation rules.
 
@since 6.2024
